name: The Register Anchor Is Content-Neutral
summary: The style anchor passed first on every render is a swatch that depicts nobody, because a character-portrait anchor leaks its subject into every frame.
rules: This universe's register anchor is reference/style/warm-editorial-neutral/refs/warm-editorial-swatch.png, a content-neutral texture swatch. A character portrait must never be promoted to anchor: when one was, that person's face and denim jacket bled across an entire book's renders that never cast him. If a book has no recurring human, pass only the neutral anchor plus the entity masters it actually needs.
origin: The Gary-face bleed incident, recorded in the make-a-hyperagent-book cartridge; anchor swapped to the neutral swatch.
